project.name: OpenScreen
project.one_liner: Free, open-source Screen Studio alternative with auto-zoom, motion blur, smooth cursor, no watermarks.

panels.beat: Show the polished after-state first: a clean screen recording with smooth auto-zoom and motion blur
panels.composition: full-frame app/demo result with deterministic AFTER label in top-left
panels.motion_intent: fast result-first clip, cursor click triggers smooth zoom, AFTER label snaps on

panels.beat: Rewind to the old workflow: raw screen recording feels jumpy and unfinished
panels.composition: gray cluttered editor screen with deterministic BEFORE label and messy cursor movement
panels.motion_intent: rewind wipe, jittery cursor, rough zoom jump, red pain-point annotation

panels.beat: The paid baseline costs $29/month and is Mac-only, while this project is free and cross-platform
panels.composition: price/platform pain card with source footnotes
panels.motion_intent: red $29/month label appears, Mac-only tag dims, free cross-platform tag waits off-screen

panels.beat: OpenScreen adds the polish: auto-zoom, motion blur, smooth cursor
panels.composition: real OpenScreen/editor demo with three deterministic feature tags
panels.motion_intent: feature tags appear exactly as each visual feature happens

panels.beat: Side-by-side: before is jumpy, after looks like a product launch video
panels.composition: vertical split-screen, BEFORE on left, AFTER on right, same cursor action
panels.motion_intent: synchronized cursor click, after side zooms smoothly, before side stutters

panels.beat: Payoff: if your demo is the product, the recorder matters
panels.composition: clean final result frame with repo URL and save/share prompt
panels.motion_intent: final zoom settles, repo URL highlights, save icon pops
